name: QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B_
description: This is the base table for storing product groups. A product group is a generic grouping of items, promotions etc. The underlying structure of a product group can be either a tree or a directed acyclic graph. Product Groups can be defined as sharable, in which case the product group and all its contents can be reused in mutliple structures.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: Internal name of the product group.

columns.name: ADMIN_REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Version Number used during product group administration.

columns.name: RUNTIME_REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Version Number used during runtime.

columns.name: REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier used for integration with external systems.

columns.name: IMAGE_IDENTIFIER_PATH
columns.description: Refers to a unique image identifier absolute path.

columns.name: ADMIN_STATE_PENDING_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Indicates whether admin is pending for this group.

columns.name: BATCH_KEY
columns.description: Column for internal use. Holds transient information about the batch process that is updating denormalization data based on this value in a group.

columns.name: LAST_STRUCT_CHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Datetime when last structural changes were published.

columns.name: LOCKED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the Product Group is locked.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOCKED_BY_USER_GUID
columns.description: User GUID of the user who locked this object.

columns.name: LOCKED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the object was locked.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: LAST_PUBLISH_DATE
columns.description: To track the time and date of the last publish of the product group.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
